title: In the mighty jungle [DTM]

replies.author: Subscriptor
replies.body: I see it as a very easily rushed & quick map, which I dislike in most cases. Move 2 halfs a bir further from eachother, also, i feel like 2 monuments, or 2 with a middle one could play better. Also adding second level to the map in the frontlines, etc, could improve gameplay a lot. Other than that, the map shape looks cool, I just hope it won't get rushed too fast.

replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
I really like the design choices that you have and I like the jungle theme to it. However as many people have said, it is a little bit too big. you should try to make the overall map thinner in both the X and Z grid. Also try adding some verticality to it to make it even feel more jungly.

Good Luck!
